name_zh: 保留动作特征的几何近端更新
formal_object: Flattened trajectory y in R^(3TV); desired geometry repair d; fixed positive definite metric W; linear protected-feature operator C including anchor rows.

operations.condition: W positive definite; C fixed before repair

operations.input: ker C and row space C
operations.condition: Protected features are explicitly chosen; not all velocities
operations.output: Only directions in ker C remain editable

derivation_steps.justification: Differentiate the convex quadratic with equality constraints.
Insert delta=d-W^-1 C^T lambda into feasibility.

derivation_steps.statement: delta*=d-W^-1 C^T(C W^-1 C^T)^dagger C d; C delta*=0.
derivation_steps.justification: C d lies in the range of the Gram operator; pseudoinverse handles redundant constraints.

derivation_steps.statement: If C has full column rank then delta*=0.
derivation_steps.justification: A full-rank observation operator has a zero nullspace; protection may forbid repair.

assumptions: W is symmetric positive definite and is frozen while the subproblem is solved.
C protects specified coarse motion moments inferred from permitted inputs/model outputs, not ground-truth motion.
Preserving C y does not preserve every motion or the official CD-M.
d comes from a declared geometry surrogate; no evaluation labels enter inference.
method_expression: Compute a geometry-only desired step d, then apply its W-orthogonal projection into ker C; retain exact anchor constraints.
distinguishing_prediction: Protected linear motion moments stay unchanged while unprotected geometry directions move; benefit should vanish when ker C is trivial.
falsifier: Reject necessity if the same native geometry/motion frontier is achieved by an equal-cost unconstrained/strength-matched repair, or if protected moments have no relationship to the native motion endpoint.
closest_alternative: Classical equality-constrained proximal projection; geometry-only repair and simple displacement blend; SFG local/global motion decoupling means separation alone cannot be the contribution.
decisive_comparison: Native ActionMesh, same geometry repair without C, projected repair, and scalar-blend replacement at matched repair cost/tuning; freeze C before confirmation.
operational_delta: Changes the admissible update subspace rather than adjusting a global regularization strength; classical projection is attributed.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse/low-rank C products and small Gram solve; otherwise a full 3TV matrix is inadmissible. Requires native baseline and strongest-simple qualification.
structural_signature: Deterministic equality-constrained repair in output trajectory space.
algebra_review_basis: Re-derived KKT solution; verified redundant-row and full-rank limits. Avoided the false claim that protecting all velocities leaves useful deformation freedom.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
